verdict.rationale: The client docs show `run_tasks_until_done` which submits a job and blocks until completion, implying asynchronous background job execution (JobNames.LITERATURE, Kosmos long-running analyses), but there is no documented notification mechanism (email, webhook, push) to alert the analyst when the job finishes unattended. missing for 10: evidence of a non-blocking/async job submission API, evidence of notification/webhook/email alerting on completion, independent confirmation of long-running unattended jobs.
